verdict.rationale: Evidence covers Raygun's crash reporting, stack traces, error grouping, source maps, and integrations (Slack, PagerDuty, repos), but there is no mention of a user-facing feedback dialog/widget or any mechanism to attach end-user comments/feedback to a specific error event. Missing for 10: user-facing crash/feedback dialog, feedback widget SDK, linkage of user-submitted feedback to a specific error event.
